states.meaning: Complete eligible evaluation set contains no matched archetype; missing coverage cannot be called zero.
One eligible archetype match with complete lineage.
Several matches share a primary family; not counted as independent by number.
Matches span primary families and overlap metadata permits a cross-family interpretation; not an action.
Future higher-diversity designation requires separately calibrated independence and coverage rules; no current threshold or classification.
Missing eligibility, incomplete lineage, duplicate event, unknown overlap, or incompatible PIT state prevents a supported confluence classification.

exact evidence/diagnostic/event/source identity and PIT lineage
overlap category from rule-based overlap model
independent six-gate results for any later actionability
